LESSON: SIGN READING 15.2.1 SIGN READING FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 15.2.1 Sign Reading Fluency, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell if a text is appropriate for reading? 2. Why should one read a text fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify signs of words related to the theme,
